title: Set up your profile
detail: These inputs let the assistant calculate targets without asking the same questions again.
activityLevelDetail: Choose your typical daily movement or physical work. Workouts from the weekly plan are calculated separately.

activityDescriptions.sedentary: Mostly seated work and little walking — usually under 5,000 steps per day outside workouts.
activityDescriptions.light: Seated work with regular walks and daily errands — usually 5,000–7,499 steps outside workouts.
activityDescriptions.moderate: Mixed seated and standing work or plenty of daily walking — usually 7,500–9,999 steps outside workouts.
activityDescriptions.very_active: Most of the day on your feet or light physical work — usually 10,000–12,499 steps outside workouts.
activityDescriptions.extremely_active: Heavy physical work or exceptionally high daily movement — usually at least 12,500 steps outside workouts.

error: We could not save your profile. Check the values and try again.
